record.conclusion: Draft sceptic view: the claim fails at the separate-outcome requirement for these two reports, with identity and units also unresolved. Human decision required.

challenges: The recalling firm is identified by name and city only; "Integra LifeSciences Corp. (NeuroSciences)" is not an Exhibit 21.1 name and several group entities carry NeuroSciences names (REL-G-1, REL-G-2).
product_quantity is reported in "units" without a stated unit of sale (box of 5 versus box of 1), so the four quantities cannot be added or converted to revenue.
No retrieved original states which revenue line contains the Extended Tip or MicroMyst applicators, so no cohort join to Neurosurgery or CSS revenue exists (OBS-G-5).

Both outcome reports attribute changes only to combined "quality and operational issues"; the only recall-named charge belongs to an earlier Boston-facility recall (OBS-G-7). No recall-specific amount is measurable.
judgments.reason: The frozen outcome object, an amount attributed to these recalls, is absent from both reports; combined quality effects cannot be allocated to the four recalls without an invented allocation.
